comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: a 3,000 Schedule C loss (receipts 12,000 less expenses 15,000) with line G Yes and box 32b checked, 1,000 at risk - the section 465 cap binds, so only 1,000 of the loss is deducted (income 47,250) against the 45,250 box 32a reaches. Tax 3,545 = table(31,525 midpoint) = 1,192.50 + 12% of 19,600; overpaid 2,455. A loss deducts no self-employment tax either way, so lines 11 and 24 follow line 9. Until this unit box 32b was refused outright.
